versions.changelog: Added cross-posting to Bluesky and LinkedIn. Every post-creating call now takes an optional platforms array with any mix of x, bluesky and linkedin, and every post response carries a per-network results array (published, failed, or skipped with a reason). New endpoint: GET /api/v1/cross-posting shows which networks are connected, which can publish right now, and where a post that omits platforms would go. Omitting platforms follows the auto cross-post setting of the account instead of meaning X only. LinkedIn posts go to the connected personal profile, allow 3,000 characters, receive a thread as one post, and skip video. Accounts are connected once in the OpenTweet dashboard, and the LinkedIn sign-in lasts 60 days.

Added DM Campaigns: AI-qualified lead outreach with human-approved sending. New endpoints: POST /dm-campaigns (create from an ideal-customer prompt plus lead sources), GET /dm-campaigns, GET /dm-campaigns/{id}, POST /dm-campaigns/{id}/discover, GET /dm-campaigns/{id}/leads, PATCH /dm-campaigns/{id}/leads/{id} (approve/skip/edit), GET /dm-campaigns/{id}/inbox. Discovery finds and scores X profiles against the ICP, drafts a personalized DM per lead, and a human approves before a rate-limited drip send. Opt-outs are auto-suppressed. Advanced and Agency plans only. Includes a human-in-the-loop workflow and no-bulk-blast guardrails.

Added long-form X Articles support. New endpoints: POST /articles (create from markdown as draft, scheduled, or publish_now), GET /articles, GET/PUT/DELETE /articles/{id}, POST /articles/{id}/publish. Markdown converts to X's rich-text format with headings, images, cover, and embedded posts. Requires a paid plan and X Premium+ on the publishing account. Includes a scheduled-article workflow and a confirm-before-publish guardrail.

Added AI image and video generation via Grok Imagine (xAI). New endpoints: POST /generate/image (synchronous), POST /generate/video (async), GET /generate/video/{job_id} (poll status). Includes workflows for generating and attaching media to tweets.
